## Preserved doctrine

R0.12 shall preserve r0.11's central result: Learn retains coordinate-specific
and joint evidence; Resolve creates one cause-preserving pair plan; every
ordinary canonical stage applies one identical operator; fixed-state numerical
cross branches remain zero; coordinate-specific affine corrections remain
independent; and absence of a justified $r$ repair remains visible.

## Closed decision R12-D01 -- Native and aligned identity repair

Tune/readout authority maps measured native $(I,Q)$ to the native pair
$(x^{\rm acq},r^{\rm acq})$. A separately identified ALIGN relation maps the
native pair to the admitted aligned pair $(x^A,r^A)$. RTC begins at the
admitted aligned pair, retains both authorities, and never applies ALIGN a
second time.

## Closed decision R12-D02 -- Pair-based iterative refinement and replay

Canonical iterative learning, evaluation, accepted-plan replay, restart, and
lineage use the original admitted pair
$\mathbf u^{(0)}=((x^A)^{\mathsf T},(r^A)^{\mathsf T})^{\mathsf T}$, not an
$x$-only parent. Every complete accepted plan is evaluated and finally replayed
against that original pair. Product projection yields required conditioned
$x$ and, only when requested, conditioned $r$ or its exact availability state.
Raw $r$ supplies evidence even when no conditioned-$r$ artifact is requested.

## Closed decision R12-D03 -- Four distinct support and availability states

RTC shall distinguish: (1) the common index grid and occurrence identities;
(2) common pair-action and ordinary-operator support; (3) coordinate-local
numerical availability; and (4) joint covariance support, the subset on which
both conditioned coordinates and the required statistical model are
available. Pair identity or common action support never asserts complete
paired numerical availability.

## Closed decision R12-D04 -- Transitive unavailable affine-correction influence

When a required coordinate-specific plateau correction is unavailable, that
coordinate is unavailable on the affected plateau cells and throughout the
full downstream causal support of the selected common operator. Finite filters,
stateful filters, and phase-zero sampling propagate that influence according to
their exact realized support; an IIR may extend it to the next reset. The grid
and pair action remain common, and the other coordinate may remain available.

## Closed decision R12-D05 -- Exact conditional product language

Unconditional ``conditioned pair'' wording shall be replaced where numerical
conditioned $r$ is not guaranteed. The canonical handoff is conditioned $x$,
optional same-grid conditioned $r$ or its exact availability state, and
immutable paired raw-$r$ parentage. Ordinary paired response composition uses
one common operator; coordinate-specific affine corrections and the $x$-only
donor exception remain separately identified; only conditioned $x$ enters
SCI-CAL. The common paired prefilter is admitted primarily by $x$-domain
astronomical-transfer and alias requirements.

## Closed decision R12-D06 -- Stable amendment trace

The rationale shall enumerate OWNER-090--096 with one-line dispositions and
identify the r0.11 comparison baseline. R0.12 shall provide synchronized
owner-ledger, exhaustive-crosswalk, clause/equation-map, consistency, PDF-QA,
and exact-candidate records without silently resolving other owner entries.

## Closed decision R12-D07 -- Raw-$r$ diagnostic lineage and presentation

The paired-coordinate figure shall distinguish immutable raw-$r$ parentage
from optional numerical conditioned $r$ or its availability. When conditioned
$r$ receives an admitted affine plateau correction, immutable raw-$r$ lineage
and event diagnostics retain the original electronics/readout step. The
rationale page flow shall remove the isolated five-line spill page while
retaining the figure and scientific content.

## Claim boundary

No implementation, configuration, test, generated science product, audit or
repair history, external literature, web source, conformity result, validation
result, performance claim, science qualification, default activation, or
production claim is authorized.
